This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]''' of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was a [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|Clone naval officer]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was [[Unidentified clone navigation officer 1 (Saleucami)|one]] of two officers on board [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|Arquitens-class light cruiser]] during the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]]. He died when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] destroyed the ship.
